definitions.text: A variety of the chamois found in the Pyrenees. -IZE -ize. Etym: [F. -iser, L. -izare, Gr.

A verb suffix signifying to make, to do, to practice; as apologize, baptize, theorize, tyrannize. analogy with F. -iser) is the usual form; as, catechise, criticise. With regard to most words, however, which have this suffix there is a diversity of usage, some authorities spelling -ise, others (as in this book) -ize.

One of an Oriental religious sect which worships Satan or the Devil. The Izedis or Yezdis, the so-called Devil worshipers, still remain a numerous though oppressed people in Mesopotamia and adjacent countries. Tylor.
The letter z; -- formerly so called.
